Widget family: WINDOW / TITLED PANEL

Strict visual criteria (PASS only if ALL hold):

1. Framed window chrome with a distinct title bar band along the top that differs in fill from the content body below it.
2. A visible outer border surrounds the whole window (not a free-floating label with no frame).
3. Title text (if claimed) sits inside the title bar bounds, not in the content body.
4. Content area occupies the region below the title bar.
5. FAIL if: no title bar band, title bar is indistinguishable from the body, no border, or missing window surface.
